items.text: Approving the following traffic modifications: A. ESTABLISH – NO PARKING ANYTIME ― Santa Clara Avenue, east side, from Yerba Buena Avenue to 50 feet southerly. B. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA W ― 2815 Bryant Street. C. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA J ― ESTABLISH – 2-HOUR PARKING, 8 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY, EXCEPT VEHICLES WITH AREA J PERMITS ― 11th Avenue, both sides, between Irving Street and Judah Street. D. ESTABLISH – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING ANYTIME EXCEPT VEHICLES DISPLAYING A PERMIT ISSUED BY THE SFMTA, 6 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY ― Turk Street, north side, from 411 feet to 211 feet west of Gough Street. E. RESCIND – TOW-AWAY, NO STOPPING ANYTIME ― Oak Street, south side, from Octavia Boulevard to 62 feet westerly. F. ESTABLISH – RED ZONE ― Oak Street, south side, from Octavia Boulevard to 30 feet westerly. G. ESTABLISH – RED ZONES ― Gough Street, west and east sides, from Oak Street to 20 feet northerly; Eddy Street, south side, from Gough Street to 10 feet westerly; and Gough Street, west side, from Washington Street to 9 feet northerly. H. ESTABLISH – BUS ZONE ― Eddy Street, south side, from 10 feet to 110 feet west of Gough Street. I. ESTABLISH – GENERAL METERED PARKING, NO TIME LIMIT, 9 AM TO 10 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY ― 18th Street, both sides, between Connecticut Street and Texas Street. J. ESTABLISH – METERED YELLOW ZONE, COMMERCIAL LOADING, 30-MINUTE TIME LIMIT, 7 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY ― 18th Stre
items.decision: ADOPTED — 7 ayes; parts D, I severed (Resolution 191015-127)

items.title: Retroactively approving Amendment #4 to SFMTA Contract #2010/11-11, Workers’ Compensation Investigative Services with Probe Information Services for the provision of workers’ compensation investigation services to increase the contract amount $900,000 for a total contract amount not to exceed $4,745,000 and extend the term by 12 months to May 1, 2020 to allow the SFMTA the time to put the investigative services contract out for competitive bid.
items.text: Retroactively approving Amendment #4 to SFMTA Contract #2010/11-11, Workers’ Compensation Investigative Services with Probe Information Services for the provision of workers’ compensation investigation services to increase the contract amount $900,000 for a total contract amount not to exceed $4,745,000 and extend the term by 12 months to May 1, 2020 to allow the SFMTA the time to put the investigative services contract out for competitive bid.
